title: nirs4all Runtime RtError v1
$comment: LOCK-RT / RT-003 unified runtime error envelope (B-018). The `cause` vocabulary and `mitigation`/`unsupported_capability` tokens are OWNED by CAP-004 (this schema only freezes the envelope, not the vocabulary). Net-new wrapper; references no dag-ml field.

verb.$comment: The runtime verb the error is scoped to (RT-001 / DEC-RT-001).

cause.$comment: Coarse wire cause (RT-003). The migration table maps DagMlUnavailable -> unavailable_backend, DagMlUnsupported/NotImplementedError -> unsupported_shape, preflight missing_module -> unsupported_capability.

unsupported_capability.$comment: The finer CAP capability token when one applies (CAP-004); opaque here.

portable_level.$comment: The CAP-002 portability classifier; opaque referenced field (null/absent in V1).
